newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thakral joint venture enters China deal.
newsitem.headline: Thakral joint venture enters China deal.

text.p: Thakral Corporation Ltd said on Monday it had entered a 50:50 joint venture agreement with Malaysia's KP Integrated Sdn Bhd to form IT Konsortium Ltd, a company incorporated in Hong Kong.
KP Integrated is owned equally by Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd and Integrated Logistics Bhd.

IT Konsortium in turn has entered an agreement with China Elec-Trans International Service Ltd to incorporate a joint venture company to engage in warehousing, freight forwarding and transportation services in China, Thakral said in a statement.
IT Konsortium will take a 66 percent stake in CTI Konsortium Logistics Co Ltd, with China Elec-Trans taking the remainder.
Thakral said the investment was not expected to have any effect on its net tangible assets or earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
